gap: Complete All flips the wrong way on a page left open overnight: it completes an occurrence nobody did. SEED (desktop 1200x800, America/New_York, clock Tue 2026-03-10 21:00; lists: project p_house 'House'): things-todos=[{id:'t1',title:'Water plants',project:'p_house',when:'2026-03-10',repeat:{mode:'schedule',every:1,unit:'day'}},{id:'t2',title:'Fix door',project:'p_house'}], route #/project/p_house. STEPS: (1) Tue 21:00, click the toolbar Complete All (label[for=toggle-all]). Storage is right: t1 [x], Fix door [x], and a new open 'Water plants' on 2026-03-11. The box reads checked. (2) Leave the page open. The clock passes midnight to Wed 2026-03-11 08:00, with no reload and no other input (page.clock.setFixedTime). (3) The box still reads checked, and the rows still show the Mar 11 one with its future-date badge. Click the box. EXPECTED (CONTRACT, Repeating to-dos): once the next occurrence's 'day comes it is open work like any other: the box reads unchecked', and 'A click on any Complete All ... flips the state the person saw (store.toggleAll)'. The person saw checked, so the click must uncheck: reopen t1 and Fix door and take back the Mar 11 one, exactly as the same click does on Tuesday evening (control A). ACTUAL (2/2 clean runs, no page errors): the box read checked at Wed 08:00. The click marks the Wed 2026-03-11 occurrence [x] (completedAt Wed 08:00) and creates a new open 'Water plants' on 2026-03-12. Nothing is reopened, and the box still reads checked afterwards, so the person gets no sign that it did the opposite. A day's watering is logged as done that nobody did. CONTROL B: after a reload on Wed the box reads unchecked, which is what the contract says it should read. So the page shows a state the store no longer holds. CAUSE: view.js writes store.allCompleted into the box only on render, and nothing re-renders when the date changes. The change handler and store.toggleAll then recompute allCompleted with today's date (spawnedAhead uses whenIsFuture), so the click acts on a state the person never saw. The project header menu and the heading menu Complete All (toggleAll at run time) behave the same way. Repro: scratchpad/recur-r7-c3/repro-midnight-complete-all.mjs. Also seen, not claimed: a When picker left open in tab A while its Every field is blank; tab B changes the date; A redraws the field as '2' with the caret at 0; typing 5 stores every:52 (scratchpad/recur-r7-c3/e4.mjs). This needs another tab to write while this one is being typed in.
why: On a page left open overnight, Complete All still reads checked; clicking it completes today's undone occurrence and creates tomorrow's instead of unchecking (contract: once its day comes the box reads unchecked; a click flips the state the person saw)
